messages:
sam_sales: Quick ask  BankNova wants a 2-week POC but with strict EU-only residency (no US subprocessors), BYO-KMS, and tenant-level routing pin. Sales needs a single artifact pack for legal/security: 1) supported EU regions, 2) list of in-scope subprocessors and attestation ETA, 3) example routing policy snippet they can sign, 4) POC uplift numbers. Need by Fri COB.

julia_sre: We can pin tenants to eu-west-1, eu-central-1, eu-west-3. Storage options are AWS EU S3 (eu-central-1) or GCS EU buckets (eu-west-3). Monitoring runs on Datadog EU tenancy but their support engineers may access from non-EU IPs  will request attestation. Will add a tiny perf appendix (p50/p99 latency + token TPS) for each region.

owen_se: BYO-KMS supported on Dedicated and Private only. Flow: customer supplies KMS ARN + cross-account role; we envelope-encrypt and never import raw keys. Note: BYO-KMS triggers compliance review (~7 biz days). Drafting a short runbook + sample IAM trust and curl to register the key.

rahul_presales: Pricing quick take: geo-pin add-on is +12% on top of POC commit. Strict EU-only (no global fallback) requires reserved capacity, +22%. For a 14-day POC we can offer a conditional promo to waive the geo-pin fee if they convert to Dedicated within 60 days (needs RevOps signoff). I'll produce two quote variants (lenient vs strict) and attach.

attest_bot: ATT-2026-410 created: Requested vendor attestation from Datadog EU for support access and confirmation of EU-only tenancy. ETA 4 business days. Link: https://intra.redwood/attest/ATT-2026-410

claire_legal: Heads up: if BankNova insists on "no non-EU human access" to telemetry, we'll need a contractual addendum + technical design (VPC telemetry proxy or Private deployment). Recommend flagging this early. Also confirm whether customer accepts subprocessor access under NDA; if not, addendum required.

sam_sales: Action list: @julia_sre finalize region + perf appendix, @owen_se add BYO-KMS runbook + IAM sample, @rahul_presales publish two quote variants + conditional waiver language, @claire_legal coordinate subproc addendum & review ATT-2026-410. Need everything by Fri COB so we can package to BankNova. :thumbsup:
